name: rutinas-de-entrenamiento
description: Gestor de rutinas de entrenamiento mobile-first.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @rutinas/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rutinas/shared && npm run build -w @rutinas/api && npm run build -w @rutinas/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @rutinas/shared && npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @rutinas/shared && npm run typecheck -w @rutinas/api && npm run typecheck -w @rutinas/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w @rutinas/shared && npm run test:unit -w @rutinas/api
